sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's digital economy grows independently of US tech cycles, driven by rising domestic e-commerce penetration and government-backed digital infrastructure spending.
Local platform winners like BELI and BUKA benefit from structural shifts in consumer behavior, including rural adoption and cashless payments, insulating them from global rate volatility.
US-listed tech names remain vulnerable to higher-for-longer rates and AI capex digestion, making them tactical shorts or underweights versus Indonesian counterparts with stronger relative momentum.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian tech names with local revenue exposure (BELI, IRSX, BUKA) as US-listed peers drag on sentiment; the +0.92% ID vs -2.22% US spread confirms domestic resilience. Rotate out of US-exposed cyclicals, add to e-commerce and digital infrastructure leaders on pullbacks, and trim positions ahead of any global risk-off spike.

Favor small-cap insurers and multi-finance names with strong momentum; trim US-sensitive banks. Position for continued ID outperformance over 1-2 months, targeting +5-8% upside on leaders.

Regulatory support for local vaccine and generic drug manufacturing (e.g., NOVN, DKHH) is accelerating import substitution, creating structural margin expansion opportunities.

Rotate into NOVN for vaccine upside. Maintain neutral US exposure; MRNA/CVS rallies are sentiment-driven, not structural.
